name: coffee companion
author: Andy
summary: Suggests pour-over recipes for your beans, logs brews in Notion, and uses tasting notes to adjust one brewing variable at a time.
starterPrompt: Help me dial in a pour-over recipe for these beans and this brewer. Ask about my grind, dose, water, and past brews before suggesting one change.
usageNote: Connect only the Notion account and database you want the bot to use. Check recipes before brewing and adjust recommendations to your equipment and taste.
